selected.title: vLLM 0.31.0: reuse model weights across engine restarts
selected.summary: New preload CLI packages a persistent GPU weight cache for restarting serving engines.
selected.availability: Version 0.31.0; Linux GPU stack, CUDA or ROCm; model access and sufficient GPU memory required.
selected.practical_use: Evaluate avoiding repeated model-weight loading during serving-engine restarts.

editorial_review.viewer_question: When can a vLLM operator reuse model weights after restarting an engine?
editorial_review.prerequisites: Linux, Python 3.10-3.13, compatible CUDA or ROCm GPU environment and accessible model weights; same-user local processes.
editorial_review.central_task: Inspect vLLM 0.31.0 preload before a controlled serving restart.
editorial_review.new_capability: October 5 release adds a preload CLI for persistent weight-cache daemons.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: No matching capability; Ollama sampling and LoopVL recurrence do not cover serving restart weight reuse.
editorial_review.archive_check: All nine episode JSON identities and seven public upload receipts inspected; no vLLM preload story. September 2 Ollama sampling and October 2 LoopVL mechanism are different tasks. vLLM 0.30 remains an unapproved queue lead, not prior coverage.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Identify the preload/serve pairing and decide whether the platform and lifecycle constraints fit.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented artifact review; no GPU inference or restart benchmark executed.
editorial_review.alternatives: Agents API browser use is a useful separate workflow. Sonnet and LoopVL are duplicates. Router/model listings require actual release verification; scores alone do not approve them.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: Same-day shipped artifact with exact setup evidence and a concrete operator task.
editorial_review.search_query: vLLM 0.31 preload engine restart weight cache
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved: the returning viewer learns weight reuse during serving restarts, absent from nine archived episodes. Title and opening deliver that task; source-based commands, exact event date and no-live-test limitations are explicit.

Corrected sample-below wording to linked sample. No guessed chapters or benchmark claims.

playlist_review.reason: Entire script evaluates one serving repository artifact for builders: tagged release, license, Linux/GPU prerequisites, preload and serve commands, checkpoint access and restart limits. Sole placement repositories; no unrelated model or agent roundup.
